name: roomwalk
description: Scroll-driven heroes: a walk through a space, or one product coming apart on black.

plugins.name: roomwalk
plugins.description: Two scroll-driven heroes built through the Higgsfield MCP. roomwalk: send a link to any business's site and it reads the categories, proposes a walk through one generated space and builds it, with the business's own photographs surfacing at each stop. exploded: one product on pure black that comes apart as you scroll — a single unbroken shot, so there are no joins at all. Frame tools are AVFoundation, no ffmpeg.
